title: b7z9.50b: wire sanitizers.conf into native_sim test builds (EXTRA_CONF_FILE or included prj.conf)
description: Child of b7z9.50 (R-APPC-009): lichen/tests/sanitizers.conf (CONFIG_ASAN=y CONFIG_UBSAN=y) is referenced by nothing. Wire it into the native_sim test builds — either per-test prj.conf include or the CI invocation's EXTRA_CONF_FILE — and verify one native_sim build actually compiles with sanitizers on heft. Lands after b7z9.50a or independently.
close_reason: Acceptance met: one native_sim build verified compiling AND running with sanitizers on heft. Recipe: west build -p always -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/tests/routing_dispatch -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<worker lichen> -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=<abs>/lichen/tests/sanitizers.conf -> CONFIG_ASAN=y CONFIG_UBSAN=y in .config, 47 __asan/__ubsan symbols in zephyr.elf, routing_dispatch suite PASS under sanitizers (west build -t run). Wiring mechanism chosen and landed: per-testcase extra_conf_files (NOT global -x EXTRA_CONF_FILE — app_identity/testcase.yaml already sets EXTRA_CONF_FILE=ipv6_on.conf and a global passthrough would collide; verified by collision grep). Pattern landed for routing_dispatch (testcase.yaml extra_conf_files: ../../tests/sanitizers.conf; note relative paths resolve against the APP dir). Twister-level proof: with the conf merged, the compile line carries -fsanitize=address,undefined -fsanitize-recover=all. Rollout to the remaining ~40 testcase.yamls + full-sweep CI validation filed as ms4e (includes the mixed-tree trap: on the shared heft workspace twister resolves the lichen module from the shared checkout's lineage — local full-sweep validation needs a single-lineage checkout; CI's single-lineage ec2-arm64 job is unaffected). Also verified -x EXTRA_CONF_FILE=<abs> passthrough merges the conf at twister level (documented in ms4e as an alternative for lineages without per-test collisions). TIMEBOX note: bead ran ~40 min (native_sim sanitized-build verification + two twister validation rounds tripping the mixed-tree trap); the sweep rollout is the filed remainder.
